mapper.insert: INSERT INTO us (user_name, user_password, name, phone, email, birth, gender, role) VALUES (#{userName}, #{userPassword}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{birth}, #{gender}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM us WHERE user_name = #{userName} AND user_password = #{userPassword}
mapper.update: UPDATE us SET user_name=#{userName}, user_password=#{userPassword}, name=#{name}, phone=#{phone}, email=#{email}, birth=#{birth}, gender=#{gender}, role=#{role} WHERE user_id=#{userId}
